phrase.en: Let's keep in touch! I promise I'll write soon.
phrase.ru: Давай оставаться на связи! Обещаю, скоро напишу.
phrase.es: ¡Mantengámonos en contacto! Te prometo que escribiré pronto.

text.ru: Остаться на связи — keep in touch / stay in touch. Обещание — I promise I'll + глагол. Прощание — See you soon! Take care!
text.en: Stay connected with keep in touch or stay in touch. Promise with I promise I'll + verb. Say See you soon! or Take care!
text.es: Mantener el contacto: keep in touch. Promesa: I promise I'll + verbo.

exercises.en: We promised to keep in touch.
